title: Focus-zoom camera model (ease, 1.5x lane threshold, selection/pair targets) has zero committed coverage — palcheck's zoomed-lane check bypasses camera_update
evidence:
harness/palcheck.odin:211-215:
		// zoom into the narrow pipe (lane_detail on — the full lane read)
		view.scale *= 2.6
		view.off_x = f32(view.win_w) / 2 - f32(8) * view.tile_px * view.scale
		view.off_y = f32(view.win_h) / 2 - f32(15) * view.tile_px * view.scale
		view.lane_detail = true
vs app/main.odin:1184-1202 (camera_update derives these):
	v.lane_detail = app.cam_zoom > 1.5
detail: The gate proves draw_bundles renders full lanes when lane_detail is hand-set, not that the app's selection-to-camera path (camera_set_selection, camera_update ease, >1.5 threshold) ever sets it. Any camera regression stays green everywhere.
recommended_fix: Add a camera-behavior leg to palcheck (or an app @(test) package): drive camera_set_selection + camera_update over frames, assert cam_zoom targets 2.3/2.6, convergence snap, and lane_detail flip at 1.5x.

title: on_cancel camera-home exit (the W3 fix) has no committed test — the parity harness wires only on_right_click/on_ui_press and its cancel scenario asserts placement state only
detail: The new hook's firing is unpinned: deleting the exec.odin call or the main.odin:288 wiring leaves all 10 gates green. The existing input_parity_cancel scenario never observes on_cancel.
recommended_fix: Extend drive_parity with an on_cancel hook parameter and wire a mirror effect into input_parity_cancel/input_parity_pad_cancel; assert it fired (the on_right_click pin pattern, parity.odin:115).

title: Boot-order camera-fit fix (r1 B2) is pinned nowhere — the fix lives in app main() which no committed test executes
detail: The harness never had the cold-boot bug (its render_setup computes the view before demos), so a future reorder of these two calls in main() re-breaks cold boot with every gate green.
recommended_fix: Extract the boot derivation (view_compute -> start_run camera snap) into a proc pinned by a unit test asserting camera_set_fit reads nonzero world dims, or add a palcheck cold-boot leg.

title: Filter/focus class ghosting (art-direction 8.4, hard req 3) has zero committed coverage — every T2 capture and the palcheck render pass focus_class = -1
evidence:
app/render/view.odin:724-726 (the ghost branch):
		if focus_class >= 0 && i32(p.class) != focus_class {
			body.a = u8(f32(body.a) * 0.22)
			outline.a = u8(f32(outline.a) * 0.22)
harness/goldens.odin:71 (default -1):
	rnd.draw_world(&rc.view, topo, bundles, flow, crisis, tick, {})
harness/palcheck.odin:217 (explicit -1):
		rnd.draw_world(&view, &state.topology, &state.bundles, &state.flow, &state.crisis, 120, {}, -1)
detail: The PR body admits verification was a disposable scratch scan ('not committed'). The 0.22 ghost alpha and the never-color-alone companion retention (shapes/outlines survive) are pinned by nothing.
recommended_fix: Add a palcheck leg: render the zoomed scene with focus_class set, assert focused-class packet colors stay exact while another class dims (alpha-bleed pixel count near zero).

title: Palcheck sprite canaries are partial: puck checks aggregate across tiers (a puck_3-only crop evades the gate) and HOUSE_BODIES hexes are declared but never gated
evidence:
harness/palcheck.odin:27 (declared, referenced nowhere else in the file):
HOUSE_BODIES := [4]rl.Color{{232, 90, 74, 255}, {242, 201, 76, 255}, {94, 203, 107, 255}, {74, 155, 226, 255}}
harness/palcheck.odin:148-149 (aggregate over all tiers):
	check(count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN) > 10, "puck LEDs", count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN))
	check(count_near(calm, rl.Color{62, 74, 92, 255}, 12) > 200, "puck hardware tone", count_near(calm, rl.Color{62, 74, 92, 255}, 12))
demos/juice.dem:28-31 (all three puck tiers render: router_basic x2, router_mid, router_high)
detail: A B1-class crop on puck_3 (router_high) alone keeps puck_1/2 LEDs >10 and hardware >200, so a re-bless passes the gate. Houses have per-sprite roof canaries; pucks do not, and body/wall hexes are ungated.
recommended_fix: Per-tier puck canaries (render each puck sprite standalone, or gate tier-scaled footprint pixel counts per tier) and either gate the wall-band shades or delete the dead HOUSE_BODIES constant.

title: Doorstep fan's 25-slot no-wrap property is unpinned — no demo queues 26+ packets at one departure
evidence:
app/render/view.odin:655-656 (and duplicated at 698-699):
				kx := f32(int(p.id % 5) - 2) * 0.13 * s
				ky := f32(int((p.id / 5) % 5)) * 0.11 * s
detail: Fan positions are golden-visible wherever queues exist (incidental coverage), but the (id/5)%5 wrap at 25 slots is exercised by no golden — a regression to fewer slots goes unpinned.
recommended_fix: Extend a contention demo (qos_contention) with 26+ packets queued at one departure before the capture, or unit-test the fan offsets against expected slot coordinates.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (view purity/replay identity, golden discipline, palette-on-hex — mechanically stamped; T1/log.bin byte-identical, 10/10 gates). P1 ~55%: camera model, on_cancel exit, boot order, focus ghost at 0% — palcheck closed the palette half of r1-W2, not the app-behavior half; puck canaries partial. Overall ~85% (render/palette surface heavily golden-pinned). Mechanically P1 sits below the 80% FAIL bar; held at CONCERNS per the charter's r1 reclassification of this same camera-coverage gap.
recommended_fix: Commit a camera-behavior + focus-ghost palcheck leg (drive camera_set_selection/camera_update/effect_cancel; assert 2.3/2.6 targets, 1.5x lane flip, ghost alpha) and add per-tier puck canaries. Test-level mismatch note: all 7.1 verification is integration/E2E (goldens/palcheck) — no unit tier for pure camera math despite the app-layer @(test) precedent.
